title: Getting there with super consistent pixel art image editing!
author: RealAstropulse
selftext:
So happy with this, pixel perfect and correctly styled. All just prompts, no inpainting needed, no manual editing, just "make her into a panda" and boom.

I cannot wait to see what people do with this, I've been chasing image editing like this for 3 years!

Hopefully releasing soon on Retro Diffusion.

It can also be used for consistent character gen in different scenes, but thats a bit more finicky, so I won't promote it until it actually \*works\*.

  
Lmk some prompts you want me to try in the comments.

comments.author: isrichards6
comments.body: Have you been able to generate animations with this? Looks promising!

replies.author: RealAstropulse
replies.body: Not with this method, but thats one of the tasks we're training it to do. Prompt guided "predict the next frame" and frame interpolation. I'm hopeful it will work but nothing to show for it yet.

replies.author: SwAAn01
replies.body:
Yeah I’m still seeing the typical pixel art giveaways here:

- curvy pixels

- inconsistent pixel sizes

- smearing on edges that should be hard

replies.author: RealAstropulse
replies.body: I tried some stuff with kontext, but it can only do like a few aspect ratios and sizes reliably. This model can do anything <256x256 pixels, any aspect ratio, or size in that range.

comments.author: AskMoonBurst
comments.body: There's something that I think you're missing about pixel art. Pixel art tends to be low resolution/detail by design. Once your things are big and/or detailed enough, there's no reason to use pixel art.

replies.author: RealAstropulse
replies.body:
Pixel art is used at a lot of different resolutions- these ones above for example are 128x192. It's more about the style than it is the size (though size does contribute). I was a professional pixel artist for a bit over 7 years :)

But, if its specifically low res stuff you're interested in, it can also make that: [https://lospec.com/i/kgc2](https://lospec.com/i/kgc2)

https://preview.redd.it/arrt9pr3vtbf1.png?width=512&format=png&auto=webp&s=30adbc1b6d112f0334f8ec4817e3e9dbc8f19cf3
